name: Intern
description: Learning the basics; works with close guidance.

name: Junior
description: Does well-defined tasks with some guidance.

name: Mid-level
description: Works on most tasks alone and knows when to ask.

name: Senior
description: Owns hard problems end to end and guides others.

name: Lead
description: Sets direction for a team. Same level as senior; the difference is breadth and leadership, which a skill test does not measure.
